authorMeta.name: pickledfunions
text:
In Vietnam and also surprised by these bold colors behind the glass panels? Vinamilk is everywhereee. You can’t go a day without seeing their Southstar condensed milk. I dare you. 

Rebranding “case study” of one brand that really stood out to me while traveling! I was really surprised to see a brand like this in Vietnam amongst the more traditional or cutesy, animal-centric packaging on other food products and snacks. It looked so new-age western to me I thought at first glance it was a cocojune or other organic startup from back home. 

I know the conversation of sustainability and animal welfare is nuanced, but I was really pleased to see the responsibility that Vinamilk has been taking in the dairy industry, setting an example for renewable energy adaptation and animal care. 

Let me know if this kind of video interests you and I should do more branding / marketing content like this!
